blocks.tamil_translation: through Wahy). Surely rising at night (to carry out worship) - that is the firmest for (the heart and the tongue) being in accord, and the most upright in speech. Surely you have lengthy work in the daytime.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مَا أَذِنَ اللهُ لِعَبْدٍ فِي شَيْءٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يُصَلِّيهِمَا، وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ لَيُذَرُّ عَلَي رَأْسِ الْعَبْدِ مَادَامَ فِي صَلَاتِهِ، وَمَا تَقَرَّبَ الْعِبَادُ إِلَي اللهِ بِمِثْلِ مَاخَرَجَ مِنْهُ، قَالَ اَبُوالنَّضْرِ يَعْنِي الْقُرانَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي باب ماتقرب العباد الي الله بمثل ماخرج منه، رقم:٢٩١١
blocks.tamil_translation: “There is no good deed better than Allah granting someone the ability to pray two rak'ahs. As long as the servant is in Salah, good is showered upon his head. The servant cannot attain closeness to Allah through anything other than that which came forth from Allah (the Qur'an),” Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.text: Explanation:- The meaning of the hadith is that the greatest closeness to Allah is attained through reciting the Qur'an.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ مَرَّ بِقَبْرٍ فَقَالَ: مَنْ صَاحِبُ هذَا الْقَبْرِ؟ فَقَالُوا: فُلَانٌ فَقَالَ: رَكْعَتَانِ أَحَبُّ إِلَي هذَا مِنْ بَقِيَّةِ دُنْيَاكُمْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٥١٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates, “As Rasulullah ﷺ was passing by a grave, he asked, “Whose grave is this?” The Sahabah replied, “It is the grave of such-and-such a man.” “ For the man buried in this grave,
